Keep image 1's very short ivory lace-trim babydoll, slim shoulder straps, olive-green waist ribbon and matching ivory briefs. Preserve the original fabric properties and adult body proportions. Soft warm neutral light suitable for a fireside scene.
Exactly one complete isolated character, all hair, fingers, cards and bare toes inside generous margins. Natural connected shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles, five-finger hands. Genuine transparent RGBA background. No rug, bearskin, fireplace, room, floor patch, table, chair, cast shadow, other person, text or watermark. Cards have patterned red backs without ranks or suits.
